description: This feature allows customers to view all their account types (current / saving) in all allowed currencies.
Share account details with social security
This feature allows customer to view all their credit / Debit / Virtual Prepaid card (primary / supplementary) in all allowed currencies.
Link / Unlink accounts on debit card
This feature allows customer to view all their loan types (personal / cars / housing loans)
This feature allows customers to view all their deposits.
This feature allows customers to view all their overdraft accounts.
Link Capital Investment account with Capital Bank accounts to be displayed in Mobile Application
Fund Capital Invest accounts from Capital Bank accounts directly from mobile application.
Withdraw funds from Capital Invest accounts to Capital Bank accounts based on approve / reject bases from Capital Invest operations team
Trading with Capital Investment directly from Mobile application for Regional and International Markets
View Portfolio with Capital Invest for the last three months for eligible markets

Capital Investments Onboarding (CI) – Web redirection: Once the customer logs in to CBOJ mobile app, from Investments tab, he can select to open a CI account and will be redirected to CI website to instantly start the onboarding process.
